runs.layer: Durable download pause across container restart
runs.evidence: Found and fixed a release blocker. Graceful shutdown called downloadProcessor.pause(), which unconditionally persists download_queue_paused=true, so every SIGTERM recorded an operator pause and the next start came back paused with nothing to un-pause it. Reproduced on the deployed runtime: resume wrote "false" at 21:29:37 and the row was rewritten to "true" at 21:29:41 during restart, leaving isPaused=true. Fixed by splitting haltProcessing()/pause()/suspend() and having shutdown suspend. Re-verified with downloads enabled and START_PAUSED unset: resume then restart returns isPaused=false (row "false"), pause then restart returns isPaused=true (row "true"). Earlier, with the pause held across a force-recreate, all 75 queued DownloadAlbum commands stayed queued with 0 started.
